name: raci-responsibility-definition
description: Define roles + responsibilities via RACI / RAPID / DACI matrices. RACI: Responsible / Accountable / Consulted / Informed. RAPID: Recommend / Agree / Perform / Input / Decide. DACI: Driver / Approver / Contributors / Informed. Guidance on choosing the right framework, activity decomposition, avoiding RACI-bloat, decision-rights clarity, combining with team topology. Not a staffing plan.
